name: Chroma Wall MR
summary:
## Your room. Your wall. Your style.

Chroma Wall MR brings graffiti into your physical space. Keep your surroundings in view while you turn a real wall into a canvas for virtual paint.

## Find your flow

Choose from 16 colours, switch between Skinny, Standard, and Fat caps, and explore three paint finishes. Adjust your distance and trigger pressure to shape each stroke—from tight outlines to broad fills, soft overspray, and running drips.
